component.name: Accordion
component.description: Stacked disclosure component with single or multiple expanded sections.

slots.name: root
slots.description: Container that owns the accordion item collection and shared state attributes.

slots.name: item
slots.description: Wrapper for one accordion entry, including its header trigger and collapsible panel.

slots.name: header
slots.description: Heading row that contains the interactive trigger for an item.

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: Button users activate to expand or collapse an item.

slots.name: leading
slots.description: Optional icon or visual placed before the item label.

slots.name: label
slots.description: Text label displayed inside the item trigger.

slots.name: trailing
slots.description: Optional icon placed after the label, commonly used for the disclosure indicator.

slots.name: content
slots.description: Panel that contains the item content when expanded.

own.name: collapsible
own.description: Whether the last expanded item can be collapsed.

own.name: defaultValue
own.description: Default list of expanded item values for uncontrolled usage.

own.name: disabled
own.description: Whether the entire accordion is disabled.

own.name: id
own.description: Unique identifier for the accordion root element.

own.name: items
own.description: Array of accordion items to render.

own.name: loopFocus
own.description: Whether arrow-key focus wraps from the last trigger to the first and vice versa.

own.name: multiple
own.description: Whether multiple accordion items can be expanded at the same time.

own.name: onChange
own.description: Callback when the expanded item values change.

own.name: trailing
own.description: Trailing icon name for all accordion items.

own.name: unmountOnHide
own.description: Whether to unmount accordion content when hidden.

own.name: value
own.description: Controlled list of expanded item values.

props.name: content
props.description: Content to display when the accordion item is expanded.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the accordion item is disabled.

props.name: label
props.description: Header label for the accordion item.

props.name: leading
props.description: Leading icon name for the accordion item.

props.name: value
props.description: Unique value for the accordion item.
